summary: feat(governance): wire pinned docs validation into doc generation path

delivery.outcome: docs_gate.py (1) pins the adopted standard 0.6.0 revision 9fb5fc4d declared by .governance/docs.json (was stale 0.5.0 artifacts, so any correct standard checkout failed closed), (2) feeds the .governance/docs managed-copy inventory from the adoption lock manifest.lock.json to the checker's --managed-copies flag so pinned external standard copies verify instead of being flagged as misplaced deliverables, and (3) adds a 'generate' phase that refuses to write before prepare_delivery succeeds, scaffolds a policy-derived compact skeleton at the plan-approved path only, updates the index, stages both, runs --complete against the saved plan receipt and rolls back every filesystem and index change on failure.
nonGoals: Reimplementing or vendoring the canonical checker
Changing .governance/docs.json, manifest.lock.json or any managed file
Retrofitting legacy .governance/docs content beyond verified managed-copy exclusion

architecture.decision: Adapter remains a verified-runtime wrapper: digest pins move to the adopted 0.6.0 artifacts, managed-copy digests come from the independently pinned manifest.lock.json (never from document metadata), and the generate phase composes prepare -> write-at-plan-path -> git add -> complete -> rollback with no new trust surface.
interfaceChanges: docs_gate.py gains a 'generate' phase; prepare/final CLI unchanged
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; the adapter returns to prepare/final only.

validation.evidence: Canaries cover prepare/final plus generate success, prepare-blocked, bad-location and post-write-failure rollback paths.
